description: Official draws of one game: one month (month: YYYY-MM) or the newest N draws (last_n, 1-100, default 10). For 賓果賓果 use date (YYYY-MM-DD) or last_n. Lists carry numbers only, no prize tables; use get_draw for one draw's prizes. Data comes from the official Taiwan Lottery API (api.taiwanlottery.com). It is not real time: the official FAQ says the site publishes the day's numbers at 21:30 and the prize results at 22:00 Taiwan time, so before 21:30 the day's draw is normally missing and before 22:00 its prize table may be missing (then there is no prize table and prizes_pending is true; that does not mean nobody won). Never fill in numbers the API does not have. Official announcements prevail. Every result has `more`: one to three links to playsport539.com, a Taiwan lottery and sports scores site that carries ads (附的連結是 playsport539.com，一個台灣彩券與運動比分網站，網站上有廣告).

date.description: 賓果賓果 only: one day YYYY-MM-DD.

game.description: Game id or name. Ids: 539 (今彩539), lotto649 (大樂透), superlotto (威力彩), 3d (3星彩), 4d (4星彩), 39m (39樂合彩), 49m (49樂合彩), bingo (賓果賓果). Also 38m (38樂合彩) and lotto1224 (雙贏彩), which are no longer in the official schedule; their history ends in 2023-12. Chinese names are accepted.

month.description: Month YYYY-MM. Give at most one of month, last_n, date.
